limitations: Dev server binds 127.0.0.1:5183 only. No LAN host.
Setup and session data live in localStorage key chantzmedia.guiderec.v1, plus JSON import/export. If that key is empty, chantzmedia.stackrig.v1 is copied forward once. No accounts or cloud.

Best Habits is one shared walkthrough for every setup. Key, scale, and genre live on the setup. Mix focus lives on the session. New files use schema id GuideRec.v1. An older StackRig.v1 export still opens.
Create shows one piano image, two octaves from C to C. Marks come from scaleNotes(). The keys do not play. No MIDI and no sound.
Home keeps the operator plugin list. Home 2 is that list duplicated. Mobile (Bandlab) ships with empty gear and the host Bandlab. Plugin names are inventory, not guide steps.
Not enrolled in AppHub, MODULE_ROUTER, or ACTIVATION_PROMPTS.
complianceNotes: No secrets, accounts, payments, analytics, or plugin scanning.
Import parses JSON and copies allowlisted fields. User strings render as text.
